reviews.t: This great for beginners looking for a natural look

claims.text: Many reviewers find the magnetic lashes easy to apply, especially compared to glue-on lashes, and good for beginners.
Several reviewers praise the natural look and the variety of lash styles and lengths included.
Some reviewers report adhesion problems, with the liner not sticking to the skin or the lashes not staying on well.
A few reviewers complain the lashes feel heavy, hard, or scratchy and made their eyes water.
Some reviewers mention that reviews may be incentivized with a gift card, and one says the product doesn't work at all.
